finalText:
Build passes now, exit code 0. Two real bugs were hiding behind all those deprecation warnings.

`src/core/options.js:7` still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `retryCount`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.

`src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` threw whenever a flag was unset. The old config loader used to default unset flags to `false`, the new one leaves them `undefined`, and the check never learned that. Fixed it to treat `undefined` as `false`.

The rest was just deprecation noise from the bumped packages, no code changes needed there.
